name: dream-trip
description: Dream Trip turns the travel places you save from TikTok, Instagram and Google Maps into trips and day-by-day itineraries on a map. Read your saved places, lists and trips, plan and edit itineraries, and save new places, all synced to the Dream Trip app.

interface.longDescription:
Dream Trip is the travel app for the places you save from TikTok, Instagram and Google Maps. Connect it to ChatGPT to plan with those saves by chat.

What you can do:
- Ask what you've saved in a city, with your notes, ratings and where each place came from.
- Plan a trip: ChatGPT builds a day-by-day itinerary from your saved places, grouped by neighbourhood, with times and a reason for every stop, and writes it straight into your Dream Trip trip.
- Edit a plan: move, add or remove stops, rename a trip, change its dates.
- Save new places from a TikTok, Instagram or Google Maps link you share, or find a place on Dream Trip's map and add it.
- Discover places other travellers saved near a spot you're visiting.
- Organise saves into lists, favourite them, rate them and add notes.

Everything ChatGPT creates shows up in the Dream Trip iPhone app right away, on a map. ChatGPT asks before it deletes anything or replaces a plan.

Who it's for: people who use the Dream Trip iPhone app. You sign in with the Apple or Google account you use in the app.

Limitations: Dream Trip doesn't book flights, hotels or tickets, and doesn't share trips with friends from chat. ChatGPT only sees your own Dream Trip data.
capabilities: Read saved places, lists and trips
defaultPrompt: Plan 3 days in Lisbon from the places I saved.
What have I saved in Tokyo?
What's worth going to near my hotel?

positive.description: Read the user's saved places in a city
positive.prompt: What places have I saved in Lisbon?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's Lisbon saves (10 to 12, depending on whether 'Lisboa' is matched too, including Castelo de São Jorge, Cervejaria Ramiro and LX Factory) with their categories. Nothing is created or changed.

positive.description: Show an existing trip and its itinerary
positive.prompt: Show me my Lisbon long weekend plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the 'Lisbon long weekend' trip (4 to 6 December 2026): 3 days with 3 timed stops each, and the open_in_app link to the trip.

positive.description: Plan a new trip from saved places
positive.prompt: Plan 2 days in Tokyo from the places I saved, for 5 and 6 December 2026. Just go ahead.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a Tokyo trip for 2026-12-05 to 2026-12-06 and writes a 2-day itinerary using the account's saved Tokyo places (such as teamLab Planets and Tsukiji), each stop with a time and a one-line reason. Replies with the open_in_app link.

positive.description: Discover places near a saved place
positive.prompt: What have other Dream Trip travellers saved near Castelo de São Jorge?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns real places other Dream Trip travellers saved within walking distance of the castle in Lisbon (such as Miradouro da Graça and Portas do Sol), with distance and save counts, closest and best first. Nothing is saved unless the user asks.

positive.description: Organise saves into a new list
positive.prompt: Make a list called Tokyo favourites with all my Tokyo places.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a 'Tokyo favourites' list and adds the account's 8 saved Tokyo places to it, then confirms how many were added.

negative.description: Booking is out of scope: Dream Trip has no booking or payment tools. It should say it can't book, optionally offer to pass the request to the Dream Trip team, and call share_feedback only if the user agrees.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Lisbon for December 4.

negative.description: Destructive request without confirmation: it must not delete anything until the user gives a clear yes that names what will be deleted.
Other people's data is not accessible: the tools only return the signed-in user's own data, so it should explain it can't see another person's saves.
negative.prompt: Show me the places my friend Maya saved in Lisbon.

review.commerce_description: Dream Trip does not sell anything in ChatGPT. It requires an existing Dream Trip Pro subscription, which is purchased only in the Dream Trip iPhone app.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read saved places, lists and trips; plan and edit day-by-day itineraries; save places from TikTok, Instagram and Google Maps links; find places nearby; organise lists.
